summary: StatusCodeFormatter is a utility for displaying and transforming request status codes based on user roles, view context, flags, and workflow-specific conditions. It incorporates rules for coloring/bolding status codes, appending indicators, translating codes for localization, and business logic for workflow status transitions.
purpose: To provide standardized formatting, display logic, translation, and business-rule-driven workflow transitions for request status codes in the placement/review system.

workflows.name: Status Code Formatting
steps: Check user role, mode flags, and status code.
Translate Sent to Pend for ReceivingCoordinator, NIS/IRP mode.
Bold status code when request is to current user and not disabled.
Append /NIS, /IRP, /Hold, /CFO as indicators based on flags.
Change Sent/Redir to Sent-P/Redir-P if Printed.

workflows.name: Inbox/Outbox Processing
steps: Translate Sent to Pend in NIS/IRP and receiving context.
Append /Rel for released requests in NIS/IRP mode.
Translate Redir to Pend for destination view.
Bold status for inbox if status is Reac.

business_rules: Sent status translates to Pend for ReceivingCoordinator or in NIS/IRP mode.
Redir status translates to Pend in destination coordinator view.
Bold status code when request is relevant to current user and not disabled.
Printed flag changes Sent to Sent-P and Redir to Redir-P.
HoldRequests appends /Hold when hold date is valid.
CFO appends /CFO and greys out AccA status.
Non-member agencies are flagged with '*' in display.
Status codes are localized for display (e.g., French translation).
validations: HoldUntilDate must be after today and not null for /Hold.
AutoRedirected applies only if status starts with Redir.
PendFlag set if request is pending and not disabled.
NIS/IRP Released status must validate for /Rel indicator.
calculations: PendFlag logic determines if requests are pending and visible.
String translations for localization uses ChangeStatus function.
conditions: If status is Sent and user role fits context, show Pend.
If Printed flag, show Sent-P or Redir-P.
If HoldRequests and HoldUntilDate > today, append /Hold.
system_behavior: Dynamically transforms status codes for grid/list display.
Determines visibility and formatting based on roles and workflow flags.
exceptions: Requests with invalid HoldUntilDate do not get /Hold.
Non-member agency display appends '*' as exception.
